name: indian-ip-drafting
description: Open-source Claude-compatible plugin for drafting Indian intellectual-property litigation pleadings. Case-config-aware design — the plugin's structural skeletons are uniform across pleading types, and the parties' chosen forum (Commercial Division / High Court Intellectual Property Rights Division — Delhi or Madras or Calcutta or Bombay — under the Tribunals Reforms Act 2021 post-IPAB-abolition / District Court of competent pecuniary jurisdiction / Commercial Court under the Commercial Courts Act 2015), nature of IP right (copyright / trade mark / patent / design / passing-off), infringement-mode allegations, prior-use evidence inventory, and registration particulars are supplied by the user via a case-config file. Drafting workflows for copyright infringement suit under Section 51 read with Section 55 Copyright Act 1957, copyright fair-dealing defence under Section 52, trade mark infringement suit under Section 29 read with Section 134 and Section 135 Trade Marks Act 1999, common-law passing-off suit, trade mark rectification application under Section 57 Trade Marks Act 1999 (post-IPAB-abolition to High Court IP Division per Tribunals Reforms Act 2021), patent infringement suit under Section 104 read with Section 108 Patents Act 1970, patent revocation application under Section 64 Patents Act 1970 (post-IPAB-abolition to High Court IP Division), design piracy suit under Section 22 read with Section 19 cancellation under Designs Act 2000, John Doe / Ashok Kumar / Anton Piller order application under Order 39 CPC and the Anton Piller line, and interim injunction application in IP context under Order 39 Rules 1 and 2 CPC applying the American Cyanamid / Gujarat Bottling framework. Includes the 6-agent drafting pipeline (Reader -> Format -> Drafter -> Verifier -> Refiner -> Overseer), shared IP drafting base with Copyright Act 1957 + Trade Marks Act 1999 + Patents Act 1970 (as amended) + Designs Act 2000 + Tribunals Reforms Act 2021 + Delhi High Court Intellectual Property Rights Division Rules 2022 + Madras High Court Intellectual Property Rights Division Rules + Commercial Courts Act 2015 + Code of Civil Procedure 1908 Order 39 + Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 + Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023 discipline encoded.
